2607.06701.title: SPEAR: A Simulator for Photorealistic Embodied AI Research
2607.06701.paper_summary: Interactive simulators have become powerful tools for training embodied agents and generating synthetic visual data, but existing photorealistic simulators suffer from limited generality, programmability, and rendering speed. We address these limitations by introducing SPEAR: A Simulator for Photorealistic Embodied AI Research. At its core, SPEAR is a Python library that can connect to, and programmatically control, any Unreal Engine (UE) application via a modular plugin architecture. SPEAR exposes over 14K unique UE functions to Python, representing an order-of-magnitude increase in programmable functionality over existing UE-based simulators. Additionally, a single SPEAR instance can render 1920x1080 photorealistic beauty images directly into a user's NumPy array at 73 frames per second - an order of magnitude faster than existing UE plugins - while also providing ground truth image modalities that are not available in any existing UE-based simulator (e.g., a non-diffuse intrinsic image decomposition, material IDs, and physically based shading parameters). Finally, SPEAR introduces an expressive high-level programming model that enables users to specify complex graphs of UE work with arbitrary data dependencies among work items, and to execute these graphs deterministically within a single UE frame. We demonstrate the utility of SPEAR through a diverse collection of example applications: controlling multiple embodied agents with distinct action spaces (e.g., humans, cars, and robots) across several in-the-wild UE projects; rendering photorealistic city-scale environments; manipulating UE's procedural content generation systems; rendering synchronized multi-view images of detailed human faces; coordinating an interactive co-simulation with the MuJoCo physics simulator; and editing scenes with natural language via an AI coding assistant.
2607.06701.paper_summary_zh: 互動模擬器已成為訓練具身代理和生成合成視覺數據的強大工具，但現有的照片真實感模擬器在通用性、可編程性和渲染速度方面存在限制。我們通過引入SPEAR來解決這些限制：一個用於照片真實感具身AI研究的模擬器。在其核心，SPEAR是一個Python庫，可以通過模塊化插件架構連接並以編程方式控制任何虛幻引擎（UE）應用程序。SPEAR向Python暴露了超過14K個獨特的UE函數，這代表著相較於現有的基於UE的模擬器，其可編程功能提高了一個量級。此外，單個SPEAR實例可以以73幀每秒的速度直接將1920x1080的照片真實感美麗圖像渲染到用戶的NumPy數組中，這比現有的UE插件快了一個量級，同時還提供了在任何現有的基於UE的模擬器中都無法獲得的真實圖像模態（例如，非散射內在圖像分解、材質ID和基於物理的陰影參數）。最後，SPEAR引入了一個表達性強的高級編程模型，使得用戶能夠指定具有任意數據依賴關係的UE工作複雜圖形，並在單個UE幀內確定性地執行這些圖形。我們通過多樣的示例應用程序展示了SPEAR的實用性：在幾個現實世界的UE項目中控制具有不同行動空間的多個具身代理（例如，人類、汽車和機器人）；渲染照片真實感的城市規模環境；操縱UE的程序內容生成系統；渲染詳細人臉的同步多視圖圖像；協調與MuJoCo物理模擬器的互動共同模擬；以及通過AI編碼助手以自然語言編輯場景。
